pages.text: Botania is the primary Tier 1 magic mod. Mana generation, magical flowers, and the Mana Pool.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Your first mana system. Manasteel is the T1 magic material ceiling. Botania's Orechid has been modified to produce Osmium and Diamond Ore (gated by available mana cost).$(br2)$(bold)Key IridescentCraft interactions:$(/bold) Botania mana tools are affected by Faefolk's Nature Magic racial (+15% effectiveness). The Lexica Botania is the in-mod documentation — read it.

$(bold)Tier gating:$(/bold) Terrasteel and Elementium are T3 materials in this pack — crafting them requires T3 to be unlocked. Manasteel and Mana Pearl are the T1–T2 ceiling.$(br2)$(bold)Gaia Guardian:$(/bold) Summoned boss, T3 content. Drops Magiblade unique weapon (20%) and Gaia Spirit Fragments. Scales progressively.
Craft the $(bold)Lexica Botania$(/bold) for the full in-mod reference — every flower, every mana structure, every ritual. Essential reading for any Botania build.
